company.name: OurCrowd
company.shortDescription: OurCrowd is a digital investment platform and venture capital firm that provides access to private market opportunities.
company.description: OurCrowd sources and evaluates startup deals and venture funds across multiple sectors to offer direct investment options to its network. Its professionals conduct due diligence and provide market insights for each presented opportunity to assist users in building diversified portfolios. Beyond capital allocation, the entity facilitates strategic introductions and mentorship to support the growth of its portfolio companies. The platform allows for investment across various currencies and includes a reporting system for tracking performance and lifecycle updates.
